categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent measurements, and legal encumbrances. The content focuses on land ownership and property rights rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
